about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells car perfume.
description: {name} case study: an ecommerce storefront for a car perfume collection, from homepage to collection page, with matching social ad creative from MMC.
brief: {name} sells car perfume. We built an ecommerce storefront, from the homepage through to the collection page, with matching social ad creative.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.

showcases.title: Homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A dark, full-width hero that puts the car perfume beside the drive it is made for, one headline, and the same image recut for a phone.

showcases.title: Mobile product page
showcases.text: A scent selector, the price and a clear add to cart.

showcases.title: Social ad creative
showcases.text: Two portrait ads in the same black and blue palette as the site.

showcases.title: A Meta ad and a Google search ad
showcases.text: The Meta ad shows the four scents in a row. The Google ad shows a product listing.
